chunks: And Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
“Indeed, Ali عليه السلام found a man with a woman under one blanket, so he lashed each one of them one hundred lashes, minus one lash.”

key_terms.غَيْرَ سَوْطٍ: minus one lash; one less than the full hundred
key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: one blanket shared by both individuals
key_terms.مِائَةَ سَوْطٍ: one hundred lashes as corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What punishment is mentioned in Shia hadith for a man and woman found together under one blanket?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal punishment imposed by Imam Ali عليه السلام when a man and a woman were found together under one blanket. It is cited in the context of discretionary and penal rulings related to illicit sexual conduct and improper seclusion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4989 - Hammad narrated from Hariz from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) found a man with a woman under one blanket, so he lashed each of them one hundred lashes, minus one lash."
